[[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] (2013–2014) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * Second team All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] (2014) * Second team All-[[ACC Men's Basketball Tournament|ACC Tournament]] ([[2014 ACC Men's Basketball Tournament|2014]]) * SEC All-Freshman Team (2012) }} '''Rodney Hood''' (born October 20, 1992) is an American basketball player who recently finished his sophomore season at [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke University]]. ==High school== Hood attended [[Meridian High School (Mississippi)|Meridian High School]] in [[Meridian, Mississippi]], and was a five-star recruit by [[Rivals.com]].[http://sports.yahoo.com/footballrecruiting/basketball/recruiting/player-Rodney-Hood-82490 Rodney Hood – Yahoo! Sports] As a junior, he averaged 22.1 points, 6.2 rebounds and 4.4 assists per game while leading his team to the Class 6A championship game. As a senior, he averaged 24.8 points, 8.6 rebounds, 6.4 assists, 3.1 steals and 2.0 blocks per game as he guided Meridian to the Class 6A championship and a 29-2 record.[http://www.goduke.com/ViewArticle.dbml?ATCLID=205700716 #5 Rodney Hood] In October 2010, he committed to Mississippi State University.[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncaa/recruiting/basketball/mens/news/story?id=5733341 Rodney Hood commits to Bulldogs] ==College career== In his freshman season at [[Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball|Mississippi State]], Hood was named to the 2012 SEC All-Freshman Team. In 32 games (29 starts), he averaged 10.3 points, 4.8 rebounds and 2.0 assists in 32.8 minutes per game. In July 2012, he transferred to Duke University.[http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/8118407/former-mississippi-state-bulldogs-star-rodney-hood-transfer-duke-blue-devils Rodney Hood to transfer to Duke][http://usatoday30.usatoday.com/sports/college/mensbasketball/acc/story/2012-07-05/duke-rodney-hood-mississippi-state-transfer/56037512/1 Mississippi State's Rodney Hood makes Duke transfer official] He subsequently sat out the 2012–13 season due to NCAA transfer rules.[http://www.newsobserver.com/2013/11/07/3344382/after-waiting-a-year-dukes-rodney.html After waiting a year, Duke’s Rodney Hood is ready to lead] In his sophomore season at [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]], he was named to the 2014 All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] second team. In 35 games, he averaged 16.1 points, 3.9 rebounds and 2.1 assists in 32.9 minutes per game.[http://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/rodney-hood-1.html Rodney Hood Stats] In April 2014, he declared for the NBA draft.[http://www.cbssports.com/collegebasketball/eye-on-college-basketball/24531506/duke-forward-rodney-hood-officially-declares-for-the-2014-nba-draft Duke forward Rodney Hood officially declares for the 2014 NBA Draft] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.goduke.com/ViewArticle.dbml?ATCLID=205700716 Duke Blue Devils bio] *[http://www.hailstate.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=16800&ATCLID=205333441 Mississippi State Bulldogs bio] {{Persondata | NAME = Hood, Rodney | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = American basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = October 20, 1992 | PLACE OF BIRTH = Meridian, Mississippi | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Hood, Rodney}} [[Category:1992 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:African-American basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Mississippi]] [[Category:Duke Blue Devils men's basketball players]] [[Category:Mississippi State Bulldogs basketball players]] [[Category:People from Meridian, Mississippi]] [[Category:Small forwards]]
